email.subject1: a signal play for Solutions by Text
email.body1:
Cliff, saw Solutions by Text acquired Triple Play Pay to deepen embedded payments and conversational commerce.

After $110M in growth financing and an acquisition, you likely have more in-market accounts than the team can cover before momentum cools, and that is where deals slip. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Solutions by Text off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Cliff, quick follow-up for Solutions by Text.

Post-financing and post-acquisition, the pipeline target usually climbs faster than headcount can. Most teams don't know exactly how many meetings they need to book to hit it, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble to recover.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show how many meetings Solutions by Text needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Cliff, last bit of proof for Solutions by Text.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to other fintech messaging teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Cliff, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Integrating an acquisition is its own kind of busy, and I know timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your sales motion? I'll tailor it to Solutions by Text either way.
